svg.aria-label: Security controls, Perimeter: Firewall and IDS, Checks every connection in and out (OPNsense · Suricata); No open doors, Nothing on the internet can connect in (No forwards · no VPN). Network: Separate VLANs, Six networks, one per role (VLAN 10 to 60); Guest Wi-Fi, Internet only, no other devices (Guest-Internet ACL); Cameras, No internet, no other devices (IP-Cameras ACL); Storage, Servers and admin PC only (NAS ACL). Access: Admin-only logins, Only the admin PC can change devices (Admin-SSH ACL); Central accounts, One sign-in system for every user (AD · CA · NPS). Operations: Updates, Windows patched from one server (WSUS); Monitoring, Logs, alerts and device health (Wazuh · Splunk · NMS); Backups, Copies kept on separate storage (UniFi UNAS Pro). Physical and sharing: Surveillance, Four PoE cameras record to the NVR in the rack (PoE cameras · NVR); Safe to share, No passwords or keys are published here (Sanitized configs).
svg.title: Security controls
